transcription.text:
March 23rd, 1990-
SIGNAPORE TRIP

LV home 10 pm Airport almost
empty (good time to depart) Singapore Air
desk Surrounded by small crowd of
Indians in saris its accompanied by
enormous leather suitcases- one tiny
grey haired woman in white sari + shawl- bore dirty
feet in thong sandals had suitcase as high as her
chest. also many huge cartons. Waited in
flight in 1st class lounge- lotsa
business men in brown velvet lounges
and at small man serving fruit, drinks
snacks, ect.

Boarded on time- wait 50 min to take off

arrive Changi airport Second afternoon
met by 2 Mercedes whisked to grandiose Portman-
designed hotel- along grand avenue of
manicured Jacaranda trees. Hotel Atrium
with 12 story-high plastic disc mobile

HOO HA!

taken to our room by our
“butler” a beautiful May lou girl
in navy blue businessman suit.
room has one wall of glass overlooking
harbor (everything over looks harbor)
two soft chairs with table between
basket of fruit. Pink + white tea “kettle”
fine China cups- dressy table TV
desk + wardrobe- Sultal sized
bed with fine percale sheets and a
brocade testa with concealed reading
lights.
Had dinner with tony + Jim in
Chinese rest. in Hotel + so to bed.

Buffet
breakfast- juice, fresh fruit,
croissant, cornflakes w fresh strawberries)
delie fish in ginger sauce, scalloped potatoes
mushrooms + grilled tomatoes ---!

Singapore
Monday 26 March 1990
Hotel Mandarin- Marina
Breakfast in Marina Club private
dining room- buffet of fruit
cheese, jam, cereal, yogurt, toast
pastries- eggs to order ect.
Were driver to the “plant”
by Krishra Krishman with a
beach bearded handsome “bulldog
face.
K drove us out to the “Plant” there
green-lush side of the road terrain
lista truels- man road to main land.
Gradually city dropped away and we
came to the industrial area (not a
vision of love birds) the Property Plant
in the low buildings connected by
roofed concrete walkways, presses in
one- boundary in other. The main
honcho Joachim- short, powerful,

amiable- (but you would NEVER
want to cross him!) took us up
to his office- bare room except for
long, oval ebony Chinese table +
some chairs- I went over a blue
print fold up the book- I
hope its OK because I would
have to spend an hour or two in
better light to really make sure.
Then down to presses to check
+ sign signature sheet of proofs
then wait around- then dim sum
lunch + bought camera back to
plant- check proofs very bad proof
of Peach Iris- plate had to be
remade- back to city and much
needed rest at 4 PM. Due for
Boat trip + dinner at 7.
Buffet dinner on boat- beautiful

familiar + strange foods
shrimps- hard gelatin stuff
meats
talapia – tiny spicy “egg rolls”
salad
beautiful warm night air- heat
lighting, brilliant sky line

Tues Mar 26

Breakfast same- with 4-5
“Butlers” watching over every move –
ready with coffee- pick up napkin remove
dirty plates- v. unnerving. Explored underground
shopping heel- nothing open- coral, rugs
shlock clothes, made to order in 10 min
clothes, same shoes as at home lotsa
spiral staircases, plants, fountains,
McDonalds, Ponderosa Café, Noodle shop,
blue jeans everywhere – in this heat!
Walking outside like sauna- walk
inside a refrig.
 Met Tony + Jim walked to metro
spotters, quiet, glass sliding doors
between platform + trains, trains
clean quiet - $500 fine for eating or smoke on
train. Death to drug dealers!
Locals say Singapore a fine place-
a fine for this a fine for that.

CHECKED proofs and then went to
Orchid Garden- beautiful, lush
garden found a bench under a tree next
to a little stream + painted a sketch of
the diverse greenery including the
amazing vermillion trunk Palm tree
Took the bus back to town thru
a neighborhood of private houses with
lush gardens- along the highway one
sees only hi-rise apt buildings-
festooned with colorful laundry each
complex has its own shopping clinic
school ect and people can get along
without autos. When we got back to
hotel - I was so exhausted from the
heat we didn't go out again –
Had room service – v. elaborate
stiff linen lotsa silver- good prawn
Salad niceous - + funny Apple strudel
+ go to bed.

Wed Mar 27
Don't have to be at “the Plant”
till 3 P.M.- shopped a bit – explored
Raffles Center- hi rise convention
center- Japanese dept store- Westin
Plaza Hotel – marble Anonymous
architecture inner court fountains
plants ect ect. Clean lines no decoration
For a city based on shopping there
seems little of interest to buy
mass produced shlock mostly
took Metro out to YI SHUN
(end of line) where Krishna
picked up + took us to the
plant. Proofs not ready so
waited in air conditioned cell
-this time had book + crackers
so munched + read til proof
time.

Cocktails +dinner in Hotel.

Singapore
Thurs. Mar 28
Proofing finished! Went to
Botanical Garden- Mostly
wonderful trees- palms in
infinite variety and weird +
wonderful tropical delights

*SKETCK* Cannon ball tree

        blossoms

        c. balls

It was so hot I faded
fast + could barely drag
myself back to the bus stop.
Went to the big blue
shopping mall on the way back
same crap as everywhere else
bought some egg rolls +
went back to the hotel for rest.
A afternoon walked out to
Raffles Center (Raffles hotel
being renovated) a big round
high rise monstrosity housing
Hestin Hotel _ lotsa shop
looked at every hand bag in
Singapore (for Betty present) + They’re
all awful no matter what the
price- stiff, hard awkward
to hold the nicest softest one
turned out to be plastic +
smelled bad.

so much for shopping
-too much repetitions
machine- made junk-
nothing unique, or family made
met Tony + Jim for
drinks and dinner at
the Sea Food center on
the “EAST” coast- a
15 min cab ride away.
Jim + Tony going to
K.L. + then Ban koh tomorrow
so this in farewell dinner

We sat at round table in the
balcony night air- ate
delicious prawns in shell,
whole steamed Talapia
spinach in sesame oil sauce
and crab baked in pepper
sauce- good. fresh fruit
for desert

Singapore
Friday Mar 29
16 CA or across the isle

Dream Sept. Thurs.

Young womans house on display
to the british public – dirty, messy
modern- smarty- everything diff-
icult kind of house to get to the childs
room- up steep steps + down a
ladder out to a balcony area -voice
says I know you’re there- I run.
in strange cracked plastic
green booties soft dressing gown
- suddenly I am out of the HOTEL
on a high street (3rd storey)
running- I am in a bus
a cape Kennedy rocket comes
down - bus is on a narrow road
with sea 100 ft below on
bothe sides bus goes thru
fig bank then on left see driver
are going thru lock – pomegranite
shaped + lock gate had
tiny fish jumping in the

gears- walking along narrow
windy st. (like Honfleur) go
into shop to buy something more
appropriate to where a loving,
charming man sells me a
pile of what appears to be
cashmere garments of many
sorts, when I have to pay for them
I examine them more closely
and they are straps + girter
belts and tight girdles – so
I want out of the shop frightened
(they want me to PAY) as the man
who was so charming has become
menacing I run through the
streets darting into alleys + side
sts. hoping they will never find me.
